StackType.issue: The sim overrides on_stack to a no-op citing PowerStackType.Single, but Single only means 'Amount is hidden, and is always 1' (PowerStackType.cs:10-13) -- PowerCmd.ModifyAmount:236 adds the offset with no StackType branch. One of the 15 units making this misreading (`py audit/tools/power_census.py stack`). DORMANT for this unit: Amount is read nowhere in it, so the value is inert. Named trigger: any behaviour on this power that reads Amount. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterSideTurnEnd.issue: SLOT. AbstractModel.AfterSideTurnEnd is dispatched by Hook.AfterTurnEnd (Hook.cs:1267-1292), which CombatManager calls at :1307 for the player side -- AFTER the turn-end card effects and the hand flush. The sim's on_player_turn_end is Hook.BeforeTurnEnd (combat.py:654, before both); the sim's real AfterTurnEnd slot is after_player_turn_end (combat.py:665). Reproduce the affected population with `py audit/tools/power_census.py slots`. Third-file citations, not hashed here. Live consequence for THIS power specifically: the sim removes No Draw before the turn-end card effects and the hand flush, so a turn-end effect that draws (Dark Embrace off an ethereal exhaust, powers.py:251-255) succeeds in the sim and is blocked in the game. Both halves are ported Ironclad-pool content. The sim's correct slot, after_player_turn_end (combat.py:665), is available and unused.

guards.rationale: powers.py:534 `if from_hand_draw or player is not self.owner: return True`. Identical, including the polarity of this AND predicate: the start-of-turn hand draw is exempt and only mid-turn draws are blocked.
Same mechanism note as power/shriek's -- No Draw overrides no AfterRemoved, so the observable is identical, but _expire (powers.py:86-92) bypasses RemoveInternal/AfterRemoved.

guards.what: No preventer out-param on the sim's should_draw
guards.rationale: C#'s ShouldDraw is an AND predicate with first-False short-circuit (hook_dispatch step 35) and the sim's hooks.py:631-641 has no preventer out-param, so which listener vetoed is unobservable. That absence is hook_dispatch's, not this unit's, and No Draw is currently the only ported should_draw listener, so no contention exists to observe.
